subject: general
question: Which among the following is NOT a classification criterion of drugs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Behavioural condition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Behavioural condition** is not typically used as a classification criterion for drugs.
 
• Drugs are generally classified based on their **chemical structure**, **molecular target**, and **pharmacological effect**.
 
• Classification based on **chemical structure** involves grouping drugs with similar molecular frameworks.
 
• **Molecular target** classification groups drugs based on the biological molecules they interact with, while **pharmacological effect** classification is based on the therapeutic effects of the drugs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chemical Structure**:

 
 
• This classification method involves grouping drugs with similar chemical compositions or molecular frameworks.
 
• Examples include beta-lactams, benzodiazepines, and phenothiazines.
 
 
 
• **Molecular Target**:
 
 
• This method classifies drugs based on the specific biological molecules they interact with.
 
• For example, drugs that target enzymes, receptors, ion channels, or nucleic acids.
 
 
 
• **Pharmacological Effect**:
 
 
• Drugs are classified based on the therapeutic effects they produce.
 
• For example, antihypertensives, analgesics, antipyretics, and antidepressants.
